headline: Is Adobe A Better Way Than Salesforce To Own AI Software Growth?
summary: Investors hold Salesforce (CRM) and Adobe (ADBE) on the same premise: artificial intelligence will make their subscription software grow faster again. The two companies part ways on how they charge for it. Salesforce gets 60% to 80% more for its premium editions than for its lower ones, and it wants customers to upgrade. Adobe has held off on price rises to win users. So which approach is paying off so far.

headline: Should You Buy Adobe Stock For Its Cash?
